name: XCW IC Title
epitaph: Held by the fed's own champion LOCO across both its runs, per his own year-end campaign post.
notes: Reign dated only to "the past year" (1997) by the champion's own retrospective; no show script survives for the actual title change.

name: XCW World Title
epitaph: The fed's own top title, held by champion LOCO per his own year-end campaign post; a World Title Tournament to crown a (further, or the same) champion opens the surviving December relaunch card.
notes: Reign dated only to "the past year" (1997); the tournament that opens Monday Night Madness (22 Dec 1997) may represent a subsequent vacancy -- not adjudicated.
